serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Yes?
Bot: Since you are always planning and inviting me to all these dates, I would want to return a favor!
You: Wha…
Did I just get invited to a date?
That’s the first time something like this has happened. 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.VeryHappy
You: It’s a big surprise, I don’t know what to say…
Bot: Are you ready to go? 
You: I would love to, but isn’t it kinda late? Where do you want to go?
Bot: It’s a secret!
You: Oh, ok. It’s just that it would be a bummer if that place was already closed.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Don’t worry! I set up everything perfectly!
You: If you say so…
Bot: Let’s go then!
